sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: External link previews on the Springsteen sites themselves (springsteenlyrics.com, Brucebase, jungleland.it, brucespringsteen.it, each with its own support switched on): with "Preview external links on hover" on, their links to other sites get a card too — in a list's table, in springsteenlyrics.com's page text and in Brucebase's wiki text. A Brucebase link on springsteenlyrics.com gets Brucebase's own card. The sites' share buttons, menus and footers do not, their links to their own pages keep the site's own detail-page preview, and these cards carry nothing from MusicBrainz. On a touch screen a tap opens the window.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Popup engine (org/iframe.org, "* generalize to URLs", U5): _extSource() is enabled by sa_pop_ext alone (on a foreign host the script runs only past that site's sa_enable_<site> gate); its scope there is the table plus the site's content area, a new _DP_SITES field extRoot (springsteenlyrics.com .project-detail, Brucebase #page-content, none for the other two), which _extSteps() also uses as its block. _EXT_SKIP_SEL gained the sites' chrome (.top-bar, #top-bar, .footer-col, #login-status) as a second line behind the scope.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: External link previews: a link from MusicBrainz to one of the four Springsteen sites the script supports — a springsteenlyrics.com bootleg, collection item or song, a jungleland.it artwork page, a brucespringsteen.it record, a Brucebase song — gets the same card that site's own list shows (tracklist, fields, scans, notes), and a Live page trimmed as on the site. jungleland.it's pages are decoded as windows-1252, which they are without saying so. No setting of those sites is needed; their hosts load on a hover from the first time.

A Brucebase date link (an event's "reviews:" link, brucebase.wikidot.com/2025#261025) shows the one show it names: venue and date, the setlist, the people, the notes and a link to the gig page; its Live page is the year page, scrolled to the show and marked. One request reads the whole year (Brucebase is slow: it can take several seconds), and every other date of that year then costs nothing, also after a reload. A date with no show, and a show that did not take place, say so.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Popup engine (org/iframe.org, "* generalize to URLs", U4): _extDpLoad() runs a _DP_SITES parser on a page fetched through _extGet(), as rec.dp; _extBbYear()/_extBbParseYear() read a Brucebase year page once into its shows (kept in _extBbYears and IndexedDB as ext-bbyear:<url>, _EXT_BB_YEAR_VERSION) and _extBbDateLoad() serves one of them. _extFetch() takes charset (overrideMimeType), passed on by _extFetchText() and _EXT_LIVE.fetchText. _dpCardHtml() and _dpExtractedHtml() are now _dpCardBodyHtml() and _dpExtractedCols() with their foot, so the external card and window reuse a site's body and columns (the foreign hosts' own output unchanged); the generic left column is _extLeftCol(). A reader may give liveFor(url), version and loadingNote; the Springsteen reader's records follow _DP_PARSER_VERSION too. The four hosts are in @connect and _EXT_CONNECT_HOSTS. A Brucebase show's Live page is the year page as https (liveUrlFor(), the target's liveUrl), scrolled by setting the frame document's scrollTop from the userscript's own window: the frame runs no script, so its own setTimeout never fired (found in a real browser before the merge).

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: External link previews read three sites through their own services instead of the page, at once and without Tampermonkey asking first. Wikipedia articles (any language): the opening paragraph, short description and picture, whether it is a disambiguation page or a redirect, a link to its Wikidata item, and a Live page with the article alone (Wikipedia's header and menus hidden); a title Wikipedia does not have shows as 404. Wikidata items: name, description and other names in your browser's language and English, and their Wikipedia articles; a missing item says so. Discogs releases, masters, artists and labels: for a release the artist, year, country, format, label and catalogue number, genres and track count with the cover, for an artist or a label its profile, real name, members or sublabels; no Live page.

New setting "Discogs personal access token (optional)" (🔎 EXTERNAL LINK PREVIEWS, empty by default): Discogs allows a card every 2.5 seconds without one and one a second with it. The token is sent only to Discogs (in a request header), shows as dots in the settings, is never written into a saved configuration file, and loading a configuration file leaves it as it is.
A Live page of another site now shows the whole page up to 4 MB; it stopped at 512 KB, the card's own limit, so a long page showed only its first part.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: External link previews: a link written without its scheme ("//www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q…", as MusicBrainz's sidebar writes its Wikidata link) had no card at all; it is now read as https.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Popup engine (org/iframe.org, "* generalize to URLs", U3): three readers in _EXT_READERS before the generic one — _extWikipediaLoad() (the REST summary with Api-User-Agent; a "/" in a title encoded), _extWikidataLoad() (wbgetentities in _extUiLang() and English, sitelinks filtered to those two wikis), _extDiscogsLoad() (api.discogs.com with a User-Agent and, when set, Authorization: Discogs token=…) — sharing _extApiRecord() (the record plus facts and links, which the card and the window now show) and _extApiOutcome() (failure, bot check, dead, other status). Their hosts are in @connect and _EXT_CONNECT_HOSTS (wikipedia.org covers every language). _extSpacingMs() spaces api.discogs.com 2.5 s apart without a token, 1 s with one. A reader may bring its own Live page fields (live): _extTarget() puts them on the target and _dpRenderDialog() uses t.live || src.live (Wikipedia: liveRoot #content). _extFetchText() reads up to _EXT_MAX_DOWNLOAD. A setting may be secret: true — the first, sa_pop_ext_discogs_token, is left out of _buildConfigJson(), skipped by _applyConfigSettings() and masked by _maskSecretSettingInputs() from the settings dialog's open hook.
